title: [Autour de La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois, pages 1 à 67] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. For a field K of characteristic 0, B_K is the Galois topos (étale site of Spec K) and Π_K its fundamental groupoid: objects are algebraic closures K̄/K, morphisms are K-isomorphisms. E_{K̄/K} = Gal(K̄/K) is the automorphism group of a point. Following the previous page, Grothendieck restricts to absolutely finitely generated fields.

The structural morphisms. The inclusion Q ⊂ K gives canonical morphisms (6): a topos morphism B_K → B_Q and a groupoid morphism Π_K → Π_Q. Choosing a point K̄ of Π_K yields a point of Π_Q, namely the algebraic closure Q̄ of Q inside K̄. On points, (6) becomes the restriction homomorphism of profinite groups (7): E_{K̄/K} → Γ_{Q̄/Q}, σ ↦ σ restricted to Q̄.

The arithmetic category. Grothendieck decides that B_K, Π_K and E_{K̄/K} will always be regarded as objects over B_Q, Π_Q and Γ_Q, carrying this augmentation as extra structure. The 'arithmetic' morphisms (of topoi, groupoids, profinite groups) are those compatible with these augmentations. This is the framework in which the anabelian, here birational, comparison between fields and their Galois groups is to be formulated.

Geometric and arithmetic parts. The kernel of (7), written π_{K̄/K}, is called the 'geometric part'. Concretely it is Gal(K̄/K·Q̄), the absolute Galois group of K⊗Q̄, i.e. of the function field over Q̄. The image E/π ≅ Γ'_{K̄/K} ↪ Γ_{Q̄/Q} is called the 'arithmetic part'; a marginal note renames it Γ_{K̄/K}. The next page identifies it as the open subgroup Gal(Q̄/K_0), with K_0 the algebraic closure of Q in K. This gives the fundamental exact sequence
1 → Gal(K̄/KQ̄) → Gal(K̄/K) → Gal(Q̄/K_0) → 1.
The next page then interprets this sequence as a limit of the homotopy exact sequences for smooth affine models U_i of K/Q, which leads to the profinite fundamental groups of varieties over Q.

Purpose. This page sets up the 'arithmetic' (over-Γ_Q) category in which birational anabelian geometry and Γ_Q acting on geometric fundamental groups are formulated.
errors: No real error. One implicit caveat: the image of (7) is an open subgroup only because K is finitely generated, so that K_0 is finite over Q. For an arbitrary characteristic-0 field the image is merely closed. The restriction to finitely generated fields on the previous page covers this.
Minor notational instability: the quotient is written Γ' in the text, and the margin renames it Γ_{K̄/K}.

ideas.what: Regarding Galois topoi, groupoids and groups of fields as objects over B_Q / Π_Q / Γ_Q, with morphisms required to be compatible ('arithmetic' morphisms).
ideas.modern_name: Profinite groups over G_Q / relative (outer) Hom over G_Q in anabelian geometry; birational anabelian setting
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (letter to Faltings 1983, Esquisse 1984); birational case proved by Pop (1994), building on Neukirch–Uchida
ideas.where_published: Letter to Faltings (1983); Esquisse d'un programme (1984); La Longue Marche (1981, circulated)

ideas.what: Kernel of Gal(K̄/K) → Gal(Q̄/Q) as 'geometric part', image as 'arithmetic part' (open subgroup Gal(Q̄/K_0)).
ideas.modern_name: Fundamental exact sequence 1 → G_{KQ̄} → G_K → G_{K_0} → 1 (geometric vs arithmetic Galois group)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard Galois theory; terminology standard in anabelian geometry (Grothendieck, Ihara, Pop)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme; Letter to Faltings; SGA1 Exp. IX/X (homotopy exact sequence in scheme form)

deep.surprise_reason: Foundational setup of the arithmetic (over-G_Q) category and the geometric/arithmetic exact sequence. This is standard and appears in Grothendieck's own circulated texts and the later anabelian literature; nothing unpublished of substance.
transcription_corrections: Line 2 likely reads 'on a donc des homom. canoniques', not 'au cas des bases connexes'.
'et ce sont les morphismes' is more plausibly 'et les morphismes (de topos, de groupoïdes, de groupes profinis) "arithmétiques", dominant la situation'.
'que je note π_{K̄/K} — ou l'appelle' should read 'que je note π_{K̄/K} — et j'appelle'.
Margin reads 'on va noter Γ = Γ_{K̄/K} cette "partie arithmétique"' (written sideways, lower left).
The '9' at top is Grothendieck's own page number; the '8' at bottom is the archive page number.
